name: AstraForge
description: Model-agnostic Antigravity skill ecosystem for reasoning, engineering, research, design, writing, data/AI, and safe execution.

skills.description: Use as the shared operating contract for substantial reasoning, engineering, research, design, writing, and execution tasks; coordinate relevant AstraForge specialist skills without forcing heavyweight process onto trivial requests.
Use when a request needs classification, workflow selection, or coordination across engineering, research, writing, design, data/AI, and business work.
Use for difficult decisions, ambiguous problems, diagnosis, prioritization, trade-off analysis, and tasks where assumptions or uncertainty could change the answer.
Use when designing or changing application architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, multi-tenant systems, reliability, scalability, or deployment topology.
Use when implementing, debugging, refactoring, or extending software and the task requires repository-aware, maintainable, testable code changes.
Use to independently review a plan, code diff, design, analysis, or final deliverable for defects, unsupported claims, security risks, and missed requirements.
Use to design or run proportionate tests and validation for software changes, data transformations, research claims, and other deliverables with objective acceptance criteria.
Use for factual research, source comparison, current information, technical documentation, literature synthesis, or claims that need evidence and citations.
Use for high-quality writing, editing, technical documentation, proposals, emails, posts, narratives, and audience-specific communication.
Use for product UX, interface design, design systems, responsive layouts, accessibility, usability critique, and translating requirements into UI behavior.
Use for data pipelines, analytics, machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation, LLM integrations, evaluation, and AI-enabled product features.
Use before consequential terminal, filesystem, deployment, database, account, or external-service actions that can alter state or expose information.
